response.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), project_shares AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, 1.0 * qc_count / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM project_counts), results AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM project_shares) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, deviation FROM results ORDER BY deviation IS NULL, deviation DESC LIMIT 10;
